title: Meydan, Dubai
description: Verso is a contemporary residential development by Reportage Properties in Meydan, Dubai, offering one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments within a 15-storey tower. About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. The project brings together apartments and ground-level retail within a building organised across two basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels and 15 residential floors. The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The range is relatively focused, moving from more compact one-bedroom homes to larger four-bedroom residences. The design includes private balconies and terraces, with built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, and contemporary kitchen cabinetry and countertops. Large windows, double-glazed glazing and fibre-optic connectivity are among the documented features of the residences. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13221. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

description: Apartments in Opus with World Famous Design in Dubai Business Bay The ultra-luxury apartments are located in Opus in Dubai Business Bay. The centrally located Opus stands out with its spectacular design and is in the middle of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. This architectural wonder not only attracts attention with its unique design but also serves as a vibrant cultural and artistic center. It is a popular nightlife destination offering a variety of dining options. The are within a 5-minute walk from major attractions such as Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, Business Bay, and Dubai Water Canal. Opus is designed as two separate towers that coalesce into a single whole, taking the shape of a cube. The cube is then ''carved'' to create a central void within the building, which is an important volume in its own right and provides a view from the center of the building to the exterior. The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top. The 96 units in Opus are available in a range of sizes, from one and two-bedroom apartments to exceptional duplexes and triplexes. They all have full access to hotel facilities and spectacular amenities. description: Reference: YHKN-T13217. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas.
